title: Engineering signalling centres to trigger human trunk morphogenesis in vitro
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11326-5

A high-throughput synthetic embryology platform reveals how transient spatial cues establish two self-sustaining signalling centres that organize trunk-like morphogenesis, enabling the study of early human development and congenital disorders.
